entries.text: Prices stop on 2026-10-16, but 2026-10-19's close should be in: a data delay (the next run usually catches up), or a market closure the calendar doesn't know (add it to EXTRA_CLOSURES in mtl/calendar_nyse.py). Tonight's decision is from 2026-10-16's close.
